fields.name: Session
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x201C680 writes the null handle. macOS SubsystemHelper::InitializeIconDefinitionComponent(ID, ID, FixedString, ...) stores its second ID here. The Windows icon system bg3.exe+0x2035B10 (iterates the 0x18-byte components) passes this handle to bg3.exe+0x1D17060 to get the CommandQueueComponent of that entity and queues a command (variant index 0x1C) there: the entity of the character-creation session. Live: a valid handle.

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: Creator writes 0xFFFFFFFF; macOS InitializeIconDefinitionComponent stores its FixedString parameter here. Live 0x0EF00E61 = the same FixedString as TargetVisualComponent +0. Meaning not established (bg3.exe+0x2035B10 hands the component to FUN_142036670, the only user of the format 'Icon_%s_%s').

fields.name: RequestedVersion
fields.evidence: Windows bg3.exe+0x2035B10: when *(int*)(comp+0xC) != *(int*)(comp+0x10) it copies +0xC into +0x10, regenerates the portrait (FUN_142036670) and queues a command carrying the +0xC value. macOS InitializeIconDefinitionComponent sets it to 1. Live 1.

fields.name: GeneratedVersion
fields.evidence: Windows bg3.exe+0x2035B10 compares it with +0xC and sets it to +0xC after handling the request; creator 0. Live 0.

fields.name: _Pad14
fields.evidence: never written by the creator; tail padding

summary: Character portrait (icon) definition of the character-creation session. situation 'respec' (Osi.StartRespec on the host, then the character editor's commands, level SYS_CC_I); born together with the other ecl::character_creation components of this batch.
open_questions: What the FixedString at +8 names (shared with TargetVisualComponent +0).
second_pass: Settled from the Windows icon system bg3.exe+0x2035B10 (stride 0x18): +0 is the session entity whose CommandQueue receives the icon command, +0xC/+0x10 are a requested/handled version pair; offsets agree with the creator bg3.exe+0x201C680.
